CODE_verdict: HOLD: one reproducible P1 blocks clock promotion; clear-only path has no independently identified blocking finding

findings.title: Successful clock commissioning can never promote because CA resolution changes the recorded binding
evidence: A v2 clock record necessarily contains a relative ntp_probe.ca_file (validate_registry lines 507–515). The installed manual record is returned by operator_state only after resolve_trust changes this path to an absolute bundle path (lines 785–788 and 824).
qualification_selection hashes the resolved entire record; claim persists that binding in the durable manual operation. The same applies to clear when its record also includes a clock action.

verify_promotions reads the historical bundle with read_bundle and hashes old[0] at lines 590–593 without resolve_trust. Thus it computes a different original_binding and rejects the legitimate completed operation at lines 598–600 as promotion_local_operation_mismatch. Supplying the correct actual binding in the result cannot satisfy both comparisons.

Independent minimal execution of the actual resolve_trust and canonical binding algorithms produced promotion binding 51fa29a4a3cc36c275e42f151b8081d3c285a52d50e456c17100482467470f38 versus commissioned binding c504ef8a5bf0b14723c91a431ce9c922d32114359bd94f0588f02f429f5a9417 for ca.pem versus /data/sel-qualifications/bundles/<digest>/ca.pem. No external runtime condition is required.
findings.reproducer: Install an otherwise valid v2 manual clock record with ca_file=ca.pem, complete its qualified clock operation and subsequent collection, build an otherwise valid automatic promotion result using the persisted qualification_binding, then replace the exact manual pointer. verify_promotions rejects the operation because the two record hashes use different CA path forms.
findings.remedy: Reconstruct the historical runtime record exactly before calculating original_binding: resolve_trust on the historical records against base/bundles/parent envelope digest, or share a single consistent binding function between runtime selection and promotion. Keep canonical structural acceptance hashing separate. Add the smallest real Linux/SQLite/files/API clock commissioning-to-promotion roundtrip using the existing lane, with realistic TLS substitute and supported offset; include a combined clear/clock record if supported.
